newsitem.title: USA: Heinz completes frozen food unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Heinz completes frozen food unit sale.

text.p: H.J. Heinz Co has completed the sale of its frozen foodservice foods business to McCain Foods Ltd of New Brunswick, Canada, for approximately US$500 million.
The transaction includes the sale of Heinz's Ore-Ida appetizer, pasta and potato foodservice businesses and the five Ore-Ida plants that manufacture the products, Heinz said in a statement.
Heinz said it will focus on the retail portion of those businesses, where it claims to be the market leader, and on the frozen retail snacks business.
The agreement was originally announced on March 14, 1997.
